descriptionHtml:
Rapoo XD61 6-in-1 USB-C Multi-Function Docking Station with 4K HDMI & Power Delivery

Expand your laptop's connectivity and boost your daily workstation productivity with the premium Rapoo XD61 6-in-1 USB-C Multi-Function Docking Station. Available at Turbo Computer, this compact and durable aluminum hub instantly transforms a single USB Type-C port into six essential high-speed expansion slots. It serves as the ultimate hardware modification for MacBook users, ultrabook owners, and mobile professionals across Egypt who need to connect external displays, transfer high-speed data, and charge their devices simultaneously.

The Rapoo XD61 is engineered for seamless multi-display configurations, featuring a dedicated HDMI port that supports stunning 4K Ultra HD video output at 30Hz for monitors, TVs, and office projectors. To handle massive external storage and peripheral tracking, it comes fully equipped with dual high-speed USB 3.0 ports alongside standard USB 2.0 connectors. Boasting an integrated USB-C Power Delivery (PD) pass-through charging port that keeps your laptop energized during heavy workflows, and built-in SD/MicroSD card reader slots for instant media transfers, it provides a highly efficient and clutter-free desktop ecosystem.
